extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of American history and foreign policy
extracted.subtask_short: historical narrative on US foreign policy
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical narrative covering United States foreign policy, military preparedness, and Pan-American relations in the late 19th and early 20th centuries (circa 1898–1915). Useful for readers studying diplomatic history, policy evolution, and international relations of the era.
